author: HonestToday

title: Love the app but new updates take away from my experience not add onto it
body:
I think it’s in the title. I recommend the app often and use it daily . I paid for the subscription although I canceled when I didn’t need as many routines. But I still loved the free option too. 

I have ADHD. Ads that don’t have a skip option do not help me. I get needing ads but i need to be able to skip at a point. Managing distractions is hard enough and I thought this app had ADHD people in mind. 

Making duplicate routine premium and then archive routines is now inconvenient is so disappointing and frustrating. Instead of making the free experience a bit frustrating add onto the subscription. I love this app I’d be happy to subscribe again,  even to donate … however how you’re going about it rubs me the wrong way and takes away from my current experience (making it worse not better ). 

Please don’t  make the core elements of your app (routine creation,  management and playing the routine ) hard or inconvenient. They are the reason I and others signed up.
